svg.title: Response time against utilization
svg.desc: For one server with random arrivals and service times, response time is the service time divided by one minus the utilization: twice the service time at 50%, five times at 80%, ten at 90% and 25 at 96%. Burstier arrivals, per Kingman, steepen the curve further. Encore's write shards are planned at 80%; a hot shard taking 30% of writes instead of 25% runs at 96%.
